title: Cameroon Baptist Convention Health Board Chronic Hepatitis B Cohort Study
brief_summary: The natural history and response to therapy of chronic hepatitis B infection in West Africa are currently poorly understood. In this study, employees of the Cameroon Baptist Convention Health Board (CBCHB) and spouses who are found to be hepatitis B positive on screening will be offered enrollment. Disease monitoring and treatment will be provided following current WHO guidelines. Clinical data will be prospectively recorded for 5 years, and bio-specimens will be frozen for future analysis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age at least 18yrs.
* CBCHB employee or spouse of an employee.
* Able to provide written informed consent.
* Willing to comply with follow-up visits.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: CBCHB employees and their spouses who are found to be hepatitis B surface antigen positive during screening.
